Amazon Urges NYC Customers to Oppose Mamdani-Backed Delivery Bill

Online shoppers got a pop-up warning of a $5 fee per order if the legislation passes, escalating the company’s battle with City Hall

By

The war between New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Amazon AMZN -3.87 % decrease; down pointing triangle.com is heating up.

On Thursday, when New Yorkers opened Amazon’s app or visited its website, a warning appeared: “NYC Council Could add up to $5 per order.”
